title: 2020 AMC 12A Problem 5
statement: The \(25\) integers from \(-10\) to \(14,\) inclusive, can be arranged to form a \(5\)-by-\(5\) square in which the sum of the numbers in each row, the sum of the numbers in each column, and the sum of the numbers along each of the main diagonals are all the same. What is the value of this common sum?

solutions.text:
The sum of the \(25\) integers is \(\dfrac{(-10 + 14) \cdot 25}{2} = 50.\)

The five rows each have the same sum and together account for the total, so each row sums to \(50 \div 5 = 10.\)

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: The total of all \(25\) numbers is split equally among the \(5\) rows
Sum the arithmetic series from \(-10\) to \(14,\) then divide by \(5\)
